translation: Wutou/Aconiti radix one piece, Heshouwu/Polygonum multiflorum, Cangzhu/Atractylodes, Shechuangzi/Cnidium, Wulingzhi/Trogopterus dung, Niuxi/Achyranthes, Chixiaodou/red adzuki bean, Baijiaoxiang/white resin, Danggui/Angelica, each one liang, Ruxiang/Frankincense two qian. The above are ground into a powder, and good wine is used to cook a paste to form pills the size of green beans. Each time take thirty pills, sent down with warm wine.
